body.name: I_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}
body.construction: For distinct \(j,k\in\mathcal J\), \(I_{jk}^{\Delta,\alpha}=[\inf\{q_j(\mathcal M)-q_k(\mathcal M):p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p),(G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\},\ \sup\{q_j(\mathcal M)-q_k(\mathcal M):p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p),(G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\}]\).
